label: TP
reason: The CodeQL report correctly identifies an XSS vulnerability where user-supplied header names (param) and cookie values (from Cookie objects which can contain attacker input) are concatenated directly into HTML responses via PrintWriter.println without any HTML entity encoding.

evidence.note: Sink: response.getWriter().println concatenates user-controlled strings (param from headers, cookie.name/value) directly into HTML output without sanitization.
Source: Math.random() used for insecure randomness (separate issue), showing benchmark includes multiple vulnerability types.
Source: User input extracted from HTTP headers into variable 'param'.
